title: ext.geminicli of AER records written by the geminicli.stream_json mapper (C.10; D.23.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim gemini-cli and harness fields without a core slot, and the mapper's recorded checks (sidecars, manifest). Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

label_facets.description: execution: the member label's facets (D.23.1), the logical identity of the rollout

session_id.description: execution: the init event's session_id verbatim

cli_model.description: execution: the init event's model verbatim, the CLI's configured name (D-333)

verdict.description: execution: verdict.json verbatim (D-335: exit_code, timed_out and elapsed_sec are never corrected)

result.description: execution: the result event's status, stats and error verbatim

sidecars.description: execution: auxiliary role -> header artefact id (geminicli.sibling_join@1); roles with identical bytes share one id

chunks.description: assistant message: one [line, characters, delta flag, timestamp] per streamed delta, in order

calls.description: assistant message: the tool_use event of each call part (the CLI's tool_id, its line and time)

tool_id.description: tool_execution and tool message: the CLI's tool_id verbatim

error.description: tool_execution: the tool_result's error object verbatim

timestamp.description: message or activity: the event's timestamp verbatim (emission time, geminicli.event_time_is_emission_unverified@1)

severity.description: activity (CLI notice): the error event's severity verbatim
